Delete Your Account

Effective 5 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-05

You can delete your Astrobro.ai account and its data at any time.

In the app

  1. Open Profile (or More → Legal & Privacy).
  2. Tap Delete Account and confirm.

If the app asks you to sign in again first, sign out, sign back in, and try again. This keeps other people from deleting your account.

Before you delete

  • Wallet balance: an account with money in its wallet cannot be deleted, so that your money is not lost. Use the balance, or email supportastrobroai@proton.me to have it refunded first.
  • Consultations and bookings in progress: finish or cancel them first.
  • Astrologers: unpaid earnings must be paid out before your account can be deleted.
  • Premium plans: any remaining plan time is lost when you delete your account.

What is deleted

  • your sign-in account, saved birth profiles and chat history;
  • AI memory notes, your daily usage counts and your plan;
  • the birth details and topics you shared in consultations, and the contact details in your bookings;
  • your account's email address and name on our server.

What the law requires us to keep

  • basic registration details (email address, account ID and deletion date) for 180 days, as required by the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, after which they are deleted;
  • payment, wallet and billing records for as long as tax and accounting laws require;
  • information connected to an open complaint, dispute or legal request, until it is closed.

See the Privacy Policy for details.

If you cannot use the app

Email supportastrobroai@proton.me from your registered email address with the subject "Delete my account". We will confirm it is you and delete the account within 30 days.
